truncate table stg.csi_service_orders;

With so as
(SELECT 
	trim(sro_num) sro_num
	,site_ref
	,accum_wip
	,sro_stat
	,bill_stat
	,cust_po
	,end_user_type
	,cust_num
	,product_code
	,stat_code
	,Uf_SF_Application
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(open_date as datetime)) as open_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(start_date as datetime)) as start_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(close_date as datetime)) as close_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(end_date as datetime)) as due_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(datefld as datetime)) as crd
	,total_cost_matl
	,total_cost_lbr
	,total_cost_misc
	--,(TotalCostMatl + TotalCostLbr + TotalCostMisc)
	,total_price
	,total_billed
	--,( TotalBilled + FreightT + MiscChargesT - DiscT + TotalSalesTax1 + TotalSalesTax2 )
	,freight_t
	,total_sales_tax1
	,total_sales_tax2
	,exch_rate
	,slsman
	,partner_id
	,DLDeleteIndicator
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(RecordDate as datetime)) as RecordDate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(CreateDate as datetime)) as SROCreateDate
FROM raw.[csi_fs_sro_mst])
,so_trans as
(
	Select * From 
	((Select 
		trim(sro_num) sro_num
		,sro_line
		,sro_oper
		,trans_num
		,trans_type
		,site_ref
		,trim(inv_num) as inv_num
		,inv_line
		,type
		,bill_stat
		,dept
		,item
		,disc
		--,extprice
		,price
		--,price_conv
		,matl_qty
		,description
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(RecordDate as datetime)) as TransRecordDate
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(CreateDate as datetime)) as TransCreateDate
		,DLDeleteIndicator
		,posted
	From raw.csi_fs_sro_matl_mst --where DLDeleteIndicator = 0 and type = 'A' and trans_type = 'I'
	)
	UNION
	(Select 
		trim(sro_num) sro_num
		,sro_line
		,sro_oper
		,trans_num
		,'I' as trans_type
		,site_ref
		,trim(inv_num) as inv_num
		,inv_line
		,type
		,bill_stat
		,dept
		,'Labor' as item
		,disc
		,rate as price
		,hrs_to_bill as matl_qty
		,'Labor' as description
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(RecordDate as datetime)) as TransRecordDate
		,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(CreateDate as datetime)) as TransCreateDate
		,DLDeleteIndicator
		,posted
	From raw.csi_fs_sro_labor_mst
	--where DLDeleteIndicator = 0 and type = 'A' 
	)) A
	
)
insert into stg.csi_service_orders
	(sro_num
      ,open_date
      ,site_ref
      ,bill_to_country
      ,product_code
      ,cust_num
      ,sro_line
      ,sro_oper
      ,trans_num
      ,line
      ,item
      ,extprice
      ,total_sales_tax1
	  ,total_sales_tax2
      ,freight_t
      ,matl_qty
      ,Uf_SF_Application
      ,disc
      ,DLDeleteIndicator
      ,TransRecordDate
      ,due_date
      ,crd
      ,curr_code
      ,slsman
      ,SROCreateDate
      ,TransCreateDate
      ,stat_code
      ,start_date
      ,close_date
      ,bill_stat
      ,sro_stat
      ,partner_id
      ,type
      ,trans_type
      ,posted
      ,inv_num
      ,inv_line)
Select 
	s.sro_num
	,cast(s.open_date as date) as open_date
	,s.site_ref
	,'-' bill_to_country
	,s.product_code
	,s.cust_num
	,t.sro_line
	,t.sro_oper
	,t.trans_num
	,CONCAT(t.sro_line,t.sro_oper,t.trans_num) line
	,t.item
	,t.price
	,s.total_sales_tax1
	,s.total_sales_tax2
	,s.freight_t
	,t.matl_qty
	,s.Uf_SF_Application
	,t.disc
	,t.DLDeleteIndicator
	,cast(t.TransRecordDate as date) as TransRecordDate
	,cast(s.due_date as date) as due_date
	,cast(s.crd as date) as crd
	,'EUR' curr_code
	,s.slsman
	,cast(s.SROCreateDate as date) as SROCreateDate
	,cast(t.TransCreateDate as date) as TransCreateDate
	,s.stat_code
	,cast(s.start_date as date) as start_date
	,cast(s.close_date as date) as close_date
	,t.bill_stat
	,s.sro_stat
	,s.partner_id
	,t.type
	,t.trans_type
	,posted
	,t.inv_num
	,inv_line

	
from so s
inner join so_trans t on 
	s.site_ref = t.site_ref and
	s.sro_num = t.sro_num
--where s.rn = 1 and t.rn = 1

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT  
	ss.SourceSystemID
	,getdate() ProcessDate
	,sro.sro_num
	,sro.line
	,sro.sro_line
	,case sro.stat_code 
		when '11 Shipped' Then 1
		Else 0
	 end as CloseOrder
	,sro.cust_num
	,customer.CustomerID
	,country.iso_country_code bill_to_country
	,country.iso_country_code CountryCode
	,sro.item
	,item.ItemID
	,sro.matl_qty
	,sro.extprice
	,sro.curr_code
	,sro.disc
	,(sro.matl_qty * sro.extprice) * (1 - (sro.disc/100)) As Amount
	,cast(sro.open_date as date) open_date
	,sro.site_ref
	,sro.stat_code
	,app.ApplicationCode
	--,sro.ItemStatus
	,sro.DLDeleteIndicator
	,sro.type
	,sro.trans_type
	,sro.posted
	,cast(sro.TransRecordDate as date) as TransRecordDate
	,cast(sro.TransCreateDate as date) as TransCreateDate
	,cast(sro.due_date as date) due_date
	,cast(sro.crd as date) as crd
	,sro.slsman
	,sro.partner_id
	,'Service' OrderType
	,sro.inv_num
	,sro.inv_line
	,sro.freight_t
	,(sro.total_sales_tax1 + sro.total_sales_tax2) as sales_tax_t
FROM stg.[csi_service_orders] sro
left join edw.Dim_Item item on sro.item = item.item and sro.site_ref = item.Site
left join edw.Dim_Customer customer on sro.cust_num = customer.CustomerNumber and sro.site_ref = customer.Site
left join stg.csi_Country country on trim(customer.country) = trim(country.country)
left join edw.Dim_Vertical app on TRIM(sro.Uf_SF_Application) = trim(app.ApplicationName)
left join edw.Dim_SourceSystem ss on sro.site_ref = ss.Site
--Where  sro.sro_num = 'SRO0000126'
--sro.site_ref = ?

delete t
from edw.Fact_Bookings t
inner join temp_SRO_Bookings s on
	t.OrderNumber = s.OrderNumber and
	t.OrderLine = s.OrderLine and
	t.Site = s.Site;

Insert into edw.Fact_Bookings
(
	SourceSystemID
	,Site
	,BillToCountryCode
	,OrderNumber
	,OrderLine
	,TransDate
	,OrderDate
	,Freight
	,Tax
	,CustomerID
	,ItemID
	,Price
	,Discount
	,Quantity
	,Amount
	,Currency
	,IntRepName
	,ExtRepName
	,PlannedDeliveryDate
	,CustomerRequestDate
	,ApplicationID
	,RecordDate
	,OrderLineStatus
	,OrderType
	,Complete
)
select
SourceSystemID
,Site
,BillToCountryCode
,OrderNumber
,OrderLine
,TransDate
,OrderDate
,Freight
,Tax
,CustomerID
,ItemID
,Price
,Discount
,Quantity
,case trans_type
	when 'R' then Amount * -1
	else Amount
end Amount
,Currency
,IntRepName
,ExtRepName
,PlannedDeliveryDate
,CustomerRequestDate
,ApplicationCode
,RecordDate
,sro_stat
,OrderType
,Complete
From temp_SRO_Bookings
where OrderType = 'Service' and VoidLine = 0 and type = 'P'  and sro_line < 899 --and posted = 0
and
sro_stat in 
	(
		'06 Cust Ap'
		,'07 Schedul'
		,'08 InProgr'
		,'09 JobComp'
		,'10 Packed'
		,'11 Shipped'
	);
